name: Oriented Gaussian Splatting
definition: A variant of 3D Gaussian Splatting where each primitive is assigned a learnable oriented normal vector $n_i$ to create a reciprocal attenuation model, enabling the derivation of explicit geometric fields (normal and occupancy) via the Objects as Volumes framework.
summary: Oriented Gaussian Splatting assigns learnable normal vectors to primitives to restore reciprocity, enabling explicit geometric field derivation and watertight mesh extraction.
